title: MemeSwap
tagline: MemeSwap allows Farcaster users to buy/sell popular meme tokens inside frame.
description:
MemeSwap allows Farcaster users to buy/sell popular meme tokens inside frame. A user can select the chain, a token he/she wants to buy, enter amount and than select a token he wants to spend/buy.
